environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate in a private VPC subnet with an Application Load Balancer. The ALB forwards all traffic to the service on port 8080. No WAF rules are attached. The ECS task role has access to the EC2 instance metadata service (IMDS v1 enabled on the underlying infrastructure). The INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN environment variable is set to 'svc-token-2024'. No Content-Security-Policy headers are configured at any layer.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB without WAF
config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, no egress filtering
